text: Amnon thought it hard: Heb. it was marvellous or hidden in the eyes of Amnon
lean: Heb. thin | from day to day: Heb. morning by morning
force me: Heb. humble me | no such thing ought to be done: Heb. it ought not so to be done
exceedingly: Heb. with great hatred greatly
regard not this thing: Heb. set not thine heart | desolate: Heb. and desolate
have I not commanded you?: Or, will you not, since I have commanded you? | valiant: Heb. sons of valour
appointment: Heb. mouth | determined: Or, settled
as thy servant said: Heb. according to the word of thy servant
very sore: Heb. with a great weeping greatly
